question: What distance will be covered by a car moving at 72 km/h in 10 seconds?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 72 km/h

Time = 10 seconds

**Concept Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed in m/sec = 5/18 × speed in km/h

**Calculation:**

Speed = 72 km/h

Speed in m/sec = 5/18 × speed in km/h

⇒ 5/18 × 72 = 20 m/sec

Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ 20 × 10 = 200 m

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
